from rich.text import Text
from rich.console import Console, ConsoleOptions, RenderResult
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.color import Color
from rich.style import Style
from rich.measure import Measurement
from rich.utils import measure_renderables
from typing import Iterable, List, Callable, Any, Optional

class RenderGroup(Group):
    """A class representing a group of renderables for consolidation."""

    def __init__(self, *items: Iterable[Text], fit: bool = True) -> None:
        super().__init__(*items, fit=fit)

def create_render_group(*items: Iterable[Text]) -> RenderGroup:
    """Create a consolidated renderable group using RenderGroup."""
    return RenderGroup(*items)
